name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI quickstart end-to-end. Installed the OpenAI Python SDK, created a script following the quickstart pattern, and received a chat completion response "¡Hola!" from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API.
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1" which returned 404 NOT_FOUND. I queried the available models via the /v1/models endpoint and used "accounts/fireworks/models/gpt-oss-120b" instead, which worked and returned the chat completion.

first_call.evidence: openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}, 'request_id': 'chatcmpl-0302d10847304333bcd13f409d0587de'}

friction.detail: `model = "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1"` produced `openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}`.

`model = "accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-8b-instruct"` also returned `openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}`.

After listing models, `model = "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro"` still returned `openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}`.

friction.where: Missing prerequisite of valid model ID
friction.detail: Had to run `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIREWORKS_API_KEY" https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models | head -c 2000` to discover a working model.
